    1 """Chinese alias identification: account representation by ranking-objective factorial.
    2 
    3 Preparation is authorized; a new Linux stage must be reported and resumed.
    4 No owners/test access, automatic retry, validation threshold tuning, or winner.
    5 """
    6 from __future__ import annotations
    7 
    8 import argparse
    9 import gc
   10 import hashlib
   11 import platform
   12 import shutil
   13 import sys
   14 import time
   15 import unittest
   16 from datetime import datetime
   17 from pathlib import Path
   18 from typing import Any

   20 import numpy as np

   22 import step28_continual_population as core
   23 import step28_continual_population_data as data
   24 import step28_continual_population_evaluate as metrics
   25 import step28_continual_population_run as persistence
   26 import step28_continual_expression_run as public

   28 POLICY = data.ROOT / "schema/step28_chinese_base_policy.json"
   29 POLICY_SHA256 = "add77dd222c8308eb013bd8226b1f6f51dc3a2403a533010322d27848c597f2a"
   30 ARMS = ("mean_bce", "mean_rank", "split_bce", "split_rank")
   31 ROLES = ("fit", "calibration", "development")
   32 ROLE_SIZES = {"fit": 144, "calibration": 36, "development": 60}
   33 COMPLETE = "COMPLETE_CHINESE_BASE_3456_CALIBRATED_VALID_BLIND"
   34 CPU_CONTRACT_COUNT = 12

   36 
   37 def contract() -> dict:
   38     if data.sha256(POLICY) != POLICY_SHA256:
   39         raise ValueError("Frozen Chinese-model policy differs")
   40     return data.read_json(POLICY)

   43 def sources() -> list[dict]:
   44     paths = [Path(__file__), POLICY, Path(core.__file__), Path(data.__file__),
   45              Path(metrics.__file__), Path(persistence.__file__), Path(public.__file__),
   46              data.ROOT / "tests/test_step28_chinese_base_contracts.py",
   47              data.ROOT / "scripts/step28_chinese_base_audit.py",
   48              data.ROOT / "scripts/run_step28_chinese_base_linux_20260924.sh"]
   49     return [data.record(p, data.ROOT) for p in paths]

   51 
   52 def partition(groups: dict, metadata: list[dict], c: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
   53     """Only public group IDs/domain membership determine fit/calibration roles."""
   54     by_id = {r["group_uid"]: r for r in metadata}
   55     train = groups["train"]
   56     if len(train) != 180 or len({g.uid for g in train}) != 180:
   57         raise ValueError("Expected the original 180 complete training groups")
   58     fit_ids: set[str] = set()
   59     for domain in "ABC":
   60         ids = [g.uid for g in train if by_id[g.uid]["domain"] == domain]
   61         if len(ids) != 60 or any(by_id[uid]["split"] != "train" for uid in ids):
   62             raise ValueError("Training domain membership differs")
   63         ids.sort(key=lambda uid: hashlib.sha256(data.json_bytes(
   64             [c["partition"]["seed"], domain, uid])).hexdigest())
   65         fit_ids.update(ids[:48])
   66     result = {"fit": [g for g in train if g.uid in fit_ids],
   67               "calibration": [g for g in train if g.uid not in fit_ids],
   68               "development": groups["development"]}
   69     if any(len(result[r]) != ROLE_SIZES[r] for r in ROLES):
   70         raise ValueError("Fit/calibration/valid counts differ")
   71     all_ids = [g.uid for r in ROLES for g in result[r]]
   72     if len(set(all_ids)) != len(all_ids):
   73         raise ValueError("Groups cross fit/calibration/valid roles")
   74     rows = {r: [{"group_uid": g.uid, "domain": by_id[g.uid]["domain"]}
   75                 for g in result[r]] for r in ROLES}
   76     for role, count in (("fit", 48), ("calibration", 12), ("development", 20)):
   77         if any(sum(x["domain"] == d for x in rows[role]) != count for d in "ABC"):
   78             raise ValueError("Per-domain role counts differ")
   79     return result, rows
   80 
   81 
   82 def schedule(groups: list[data.Group], c: dict) -> tuple[list, int]:
   83     if len(groups) != 144 or len({g.uid for g in groups}) != 144:
   84         raise ValueError("Only 144 fitting groups can enter the optimizer")
   85     seed = data.seed_for(c["schedule_seed"], "BASE_JOINT", "current")
   86     return data.schedule(groups, 6, seed), seed

   89 def model_config(c: dict, arm: str) -> dict:
   90     if arm not in ARMS:
   91         raise ValueError("Unknown model")
   92     return {"model": {**c["models"][arm], **c["input"]},
   93             "optimizer": c["optimizer"], "initialization_seed": c["initialization_seed"]}

   95 
   96 def pooling_modes(pool: Any) -> list[str]:
   97     """Read actual native pooling across the installed and legacy module APIs."""
   98     mode = getattr(pool, "pooling_mode", None)
   99     if isinstance(mode, str):
  100         return [mode]
  101     if isinstance(mode, (tuple, list)) and all(isinstance(value, str) for value in mode):
  102         return list(mode)
  103     if mode is not None:
  104         raise ValueError("Unrecognized native pooling representation")
  105     names = {"pooling_mode_cls_token": "cls", "pooling_mode_mean_tokens": "mean"}
  106     return [names.get(key, key) for key, value in vars(pool).items()
  107             if key.startswith("pooling_mode_") and value is True]
  108 
  109 
  110 def load_model(c: dict, arm: str, device: str = "cuda:0") -> Any:
  111     import torch
  112     from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
  113     m = c["models"][arm]
  114     torch.manual_seed(c["initialization_seed"])
  115     encoder = SentenceTransformer(str(data.ROOT / m["path"]), device=device,
  116                                   local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
  117     encoder.default_prompt_name = None
  118     encoder.max_seq_length = c["input"]["token_budget"]
  119     pools = [v for v in encoder if type(v).__name__ == "Pooling"]
  120     has_dense = any(type(v).__name__ == "Dense" for v in encoder)
  121     if len(pools) != 1 or has_dense != m["dense_module"]:
  122         raise ValueError("Native encoder modules differ from the registered model")
  123     pool = pools[0]
  124     if pooling_modes(pool) != [m["pooling"]] or encoder.get_sentence_embedding_dimension() != m["embedding_dim"]:
  125         raise ValueError("Native pooling or output dimension differs")
  126     if c["input"]["activation_checkpointing"]:
  127         encoder[0].auto_model.gradient_checkpointing_enable(
  128             gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={"use_reentrant": False, "preserve_rng_state": True})
  129     torch.manual_seed(c["initialization_seed"])
  130     return core.build_model(encoder, c["interventions"][arm]["account_dim"],
  131                             c["input"]["head_hidden"]).to(device)
  132 
  133 
  134 def record_texts(group: data.Group, representation: str) -> list[str]:
  135     records = [row for items in group.items for row in items]
  136     if representation == "combined_mean":
  137         return [title + "\n" + description for _, title, description in records]
  138     if representation == "separate_moments":
  139         return [title for _, title, _ in records] + [description for _, _, description in records]
  140     raise ValueError("Unknown account representation")
  141 
  142 
  143 def pool_channels(vectors: Any, counts: list[int], representation: str,
  144                   epsilon: float = 1e-8) -> Any:
  145     """Population moments, all items, with no ID/count/domain feature."""
  146     import torch
  147     if representation == "combined_mean":
  148         return core.pool_records(vectors, counts)
  149     if (representation != "separate_moments" or not counts or any(n <= 0 for n in counts)
  150             or len(vectors) != 2 * sum(counts) or epsilon != 1e-8):
  151         raise ValueError("Channel/account alignment or moment definition differs")
  152     normalized = torch.nn.functional.normalize(vectors.float(), dim=1)
  153     title, description = normalized.split(sum(counts))
  154     accounts = []
  155     for left, right in zip(title.split(counts), description.split(counts), strict=True):
  156         parts = []
  157         for channel in (left, right):
  158             mean = channel.mean(0)
  159             std = ((channel - mean).square().mean(0) + epsilon).sqrt()
  160             parts.extend((mean, std))
  161         accounts.append(torch.cat(parts))
  162     return torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.stack(accounts), dim=1)
  163 
  164 
  165 def objectives(predicted: Any, truth: Any, rank_weight: float) -> dict:
  166     """Each query averages its positive logits, never positive or negative pairs twice in BCE."""
  167     import torch
  168     if (predicted.shape != (378,) or truth.shape != (378,)
  169             or not torch.isfinite(predicted).all() or not torch.isin(truth, truth.new_tensor([0, 1])).all()
  170             or int(truth.sum()) != 20 or rank_weight not in (0, 1)):
  171         raise ValueError("Expected complete finite 28-account supervision and fixed loss weight")
  172     left, right = torch.triu_indices(28, 28, 1, device=predicted.device)
  173     positive = torch.zeros((28, 28), dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
  174     positive[left, right] = truth.bool()
  175     positive[right, left] = truth.bool()
  176     degrees = positive.sum(1)
  177     if (int((degrees == 1).sum()) != 16 or int((degrees == 2).sum()) != 12):
  178         raise ValueError("Expected eight two-alias and four three-alias positive components")
  179     # Same-controller labels must be transitive; a degree-two cycle is not a controller.
  180     paths = positive.float() @ positive.float()
  181     diagonal = torch.eye(28, dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
  182     if ((paths > 0) & ~positive & ~diagonal).any():
  183         raise ValueError("Positive relations are not disjoint controller cliques")
  184     scores = predicted.new_zeros((28, 28))
  185     scores[left, right] = predicted
  186     scores[right, left] = predicted
  187     log_denominator = torch.logsumexp(scores.masked_fill(diagonal, -torch.inf), dim=1)
  188     positive_mean = scores.masked_fill(~positive, 0).sum(1) / degrees
  189     rank = (log_denominator - positive_mean).mean()
  190     bce = torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(predicted, truth, reduction="mean")
  191     return {"bce": bce, "rank": rank, "total": bce + rank_weight * rank}
  192 
  193 
  194 def account_vectors(model: Any, group: data.Group, c: dict, arm: str,
  195                     check: Any = lambda: None) -> Any:
  196     import contextlib
  197     import torch
  198     device = next(model.parameters()).device
  199     representation = c["interventions"][arm]["representation"]
  200     texts = record_texts(group, representation)
  201     batch_size = c["input"]["microbatch"]
  202     vectors = []
  203     for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
  204         check()
  205         batch = model.encoder.tokenizer(texts[i:i + batch_size], padding=True,
  206                                         truncation=False, return_tensors="pt")
  207         if batch["input_ids"].shape[1] > c["input"]["token_budget"]:
  208             raise ValueError("Input exceeds token limit; no truncation is allowed")
  209         batch = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in batch.items()}
  210         context = (torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
  211                    if device.type == "cuda" and c["input"]["encoder_bf16"]
  212                    else contextlib.nullcontext())
  213         with context:
  214             vectors.append(model.encoder(batch)["sentence_embedding"].float())
  215     return pool_channels(torch.cat(vectors), [len(rows) for rows in group.items],
  216                          representation, c["representation"]["variance_epsilon"])
  217 
  218 
  219 def logits(model: Any, group: data.Group, c: dict, arm: str, check: Any = lambda: None) -> Any:
  220     return model.pair_logits(account_vectors(model, group, c, arm, check))
  221 
  222 
  223 def score(model: Any, groups: list, c: dict, arm: str, check: Any = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:
  224     import torch
  225     model.eval()
  226     with torch.inference_mode():
  227         values = np.stack([logits(model, g, c, arm, check).float().cpu().numpy() for g in groups])
  228     if values.shape != (len(groups), 378) or values.dtype != np.float32 or not np.isfinite(values).all():
  229         raise ValueError("Incomplete/nonfinite blind scores")
  230     return values
  231 
  232 
  233 def update(model: Any, optimizer: Any, group: data.Group, c: dict, arm: str,
  234            seed: int, *, observe: bool = False, check: Any = lambda: None) -> dict:
  235     import torch
  236     if group.labels is None:
  237         raise ValueError("A fitting group must carry authorized supervision")
  238     model.train()
  239     optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
  240     before = {name: core.state_digest(module.state_dict())
  241               for name, module in (("encoder", model.encoder), ("head", model.head))} if observe else {}
  242     torch.manual_seed(seed)
  243     predicted = logits(model, group, c, arm, check)
  244     truth = torch.tensor(group.labels, dtype=torch.float32, device=predicted.device)
  245     if predicted.shape != truth.shape or not torch.isfinite(predicted).all():
  246         raise ValueError("Nonfinite or misaligned logits")
  247     terms = objectives(predicted, truth, c["interventions"][arm]["rank_weight"])
  248     loss = terms["total"]
  249     loss.backward()
  250     evidence = {}
  251     if observe:
  252         for name, module in (("encoder", model.encoder), ("head", model.head)):
  253             norms = [float(p.grad.float().norm()) for p in module.parameters() if p.grad is not None]
  254             if not norms or not np.isfinite(norms).all() or max(norms) <= 0:
  255                 raise ValueError("Encoder/head has no finite nonzero gradient")
  256             evidence[name] = {"finite_nonzero_gradient": True}
  257     norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), c["optimizer"]["clip_norm"], error_if_nonfinite=True)
  258     check()
  259     optimizer.step()
  260     if observe:
  261         for name, module in (("encoder", model.encoder), ("head", model.head)):
  262             if core.state_digest(module.state_dict()) == before[name]:
  263                 raise ValueError("Encoder/head parameters did not change")
  264             evidence[name]["parameters_changed"] = True
  265     return {**{name: float(value.detach()) for name, value in terms.items()},
  266             "gradient_norm_before_clip": float(norm), "modules": evidence}
  267 
  268 
  269 def binary_counts(labels: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray, threshold: float) -> np.ndarray:
  270     y, s = np.asarray(labels), np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64)
  271     if (y.ndim != 2 or y.shape != s.shape or not np.isin(y, (0, 1)).all()
  272             or not np.isfinite(s).all() or not np.isfinite(threshold)):
  273         raise ValueError("Aligned binary labels and finite scores/threshold required")
  274     positive, predicted = y == 1, s >= float(threshold)
  275     return np.stack([(positive & predicted).sum(1), (~positive & predicted).sum(1),
  276                      (positive & ~predicted).sum(1), (~positive & ~predicted).sum(1)], axis=1)
  277 
  278 
  279 def calibrate(labels: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray, domains: list[str], maximum_fpr: float = .001) -> dict:
  280     """One global threshold; calibrated solely against each train-calibration domain."""
  281     y, s = np.asarray(labels), np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64)
  282     if (maximum_fpr != .001 or y.shape != s.shape or y.ndim != 2 or len(domains) != len(y)
  283             or set(domains) != set("ABC") or not np.isin(y, (0, 1)).all() or not np.isfinite(s).all()):
  284         raise ValueError("Invalid calibration inputs or unapproved FPR target")
  285     bounds = {}
  286     for d in "ABC":
  287         rows = np.asarray(domains) == d
  288         negative = np.sort(s[rows][y[rows] == 0])[::-1]
  289         if not len(negative) or not np.any(y[rows] == 1):
  290             raise ValueError("Calibration domain needs both classes")
  291         allowed = len(negative) // 1000
  292         boundary = float(negative[allowed])
  293         threshold = float(np.nextafter(np.float64(boundary), np.float64(np.inf)))
  294         if not np.isfinite(threshold):
  295             raise ValueError("Calibration threshold overflow")
  296         bounds[d] = {"negative_pairs": len(negative), "allowed_false_positives": allowed,
  297                      "next_negative_logit": boundary, "threshold": threshold}
  298     threshold = max(row["threshold"] for row in bounds.values())
  299     counts = binary_counts(y, s, threshold)
  300     totals = {d: counts[np.asarray(domains) == d].sum(0).tolist() for d in "ABC"}
  301     if any(totals[d][1] > bounds[d]["allowed_false_positives"] for d in "ABC"):
  302         raise ValueError("Calibration did not satisfy its false-positive cap")
  303     return {"threshold": threshold, "prediction": "float64(logit)>=float64(threshold)",
  304             "source_role": "train_calibration_only", "bounds": bounds,
  305             "counts_by_domain": totals, "counts_by_group": counts.tolist()}
  306 
  307 
  308 def checkpoint_point(model: Any, optimizer: Any, c: dict, arm: str, epoch: int,
  309                      groups: dict, out: Path, budget: persistence.Budget) -> dict:
  310     started = time.monotonic()
  311     name = f"epoch{epoch}"
  312     before = {role: score(model, groups[role], c, arm, budget.check) for role in ROLES}
  313     checkpoint = out / "work" / f"{name}.pt"
  314     metadata = {"arm": arm, "epoch": epoch, "config": c}
  315     budget.check(persistence.checkpoint_reserve(model, optimizer))
  316     saved = core.save_state(checkpoint, model, optimizer, metadata)
  317     if core.restore_state(checkpoint, model, optimizer, saved["state_sha256"]) != metadata:
  318         raise ValueError("Restored model/optimizer metadata differs")
  319     point = {"epoch": epoch, "arm": arm, "full_model_and_adam_reloaded": True,
  320              "checkpoint": saved, "model_state_sha256": core.state_digest(model.state_dict()), "scores": {}}
  321     for role in ROLES:
  322         after = score(model, groups[role], c, arm, budget.check)
  323         if not np.array_equal(before[role], after):
  324             raise ValueError("Complete scores differ after actual model/Adam restore")
  325         path = out / "scores" / f"{name}_{role}.npy"
  326         np.save(path, before[role], allow_pickle=False)
  327         point["scores"][role] = data.record(path, out)
  328     target = out / "models" / f"{name}.pt"
  329     budget.check(persistence.checkpoint_reserve(model, None))
  330     retained = core.save_state(target, model, None, metadata)
  331     core.restore_state(target, model, None, retained["state_sha256"])
  332     if core.state_digest(model.state_dict()) != point["model_state_sha256"]:
  333         raise ValueError("Retained inference model differs")
  334     point["model"] = {**retained, "path": target.relative_to(out).as_posix(), "actual_reload_verified": True}
  335     # Force a disk observation while inference and full optimizer files coexist.
  336     budget.check(1)
  337     persistence.remove_work_file(checkpoint, out)
  338     point["point_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - started
  339     return point
  340 
  341 
  342 def train_arm(out: Path, arm: str, c: dict, groups: dict, partition_rows: dict,
  343               budget: persistence.Budget, preflight: dict) -> dict:
  344     import torch
  345     device = torch.cuda.current_device()
  346     torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
  347     torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device)
  348     arm_started = time.monotonic()
  349     initial_allocated = torch.cuda.memory_allocated(device)
  350     initial_reserved = torch.cuda.memory_reserved(device)
  351     out.mkdir()
  352     for directory in ("work", "models", "scores"):
  353         (out / directory).mkdir()
  354     model = load_model(c, arm)
  355     if core.state_digest(model.state_dict()) != preflight["initial_model_state_sha256"]:
  356         raise ValueError("Preflight and formal initialization differ")
  357     optimizer = core.make_optimizer(model, c)
  358     rows, seed = schedule(groups["fit"], c)
  359     r = {"arm": arm, "points": {}, "training": [], "label_parses": 0,
  360          "parameter_count": sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()),
  361          "trainable_parameter_count": sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
  362          "preflight": preflight, "fit_group_ids": [g.uid for g in groups["fit"]],
  363          "calibration_group_ids": [g.uid for g in groups["calibration"]]}
  364     total_training = 0.
  365     for start, stop, epoch in ((0, 432, 3), (432, 864, 6)):
  366         started = time.monotonic()
  367         losses, evidence = [], {}
  368         for i in range(start, stop):
  369             log = update(model, optimizer, rows[i], c, arm, data.seed_for(seed, i, "dropout"),
  370                          observe=(i == start), check=budget.check)
  371             losses.append([log[name] for name in ("bce", "rank", "total")])
  372             if i == start:
  373                 evidence = log["modules"]
  374             if i in (start, stop - 1) and (not optimizer.state or any(
  375                     float(v["step"]) != i + 1 for v in optimizer.state.values())):
  376                 raise ValueError("Adam continuity or update count differs")
  377             if (i + 1) % 24 == 0:
  378                 print(data.json_bytes({"event": "updates", "arm": arm, "completed": i + 1,
  379                                        **budget.state()}).decode(), flush=True)
  380         elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
  381         total_training += elapsed
  382         r["training"].append({"start": start, "stop": stop, "updates": stop - start,
  383                               "first_update_modules": evidence, "seconds": elapsed,
  384                               "losses_by_epoch": dict(zip(("bce", "rank", "total"),
  385                                   np.asarray(losses).reshape(3, 144, 3).mean(1).T.tolist()))})
  386         point = checkpoint_point(model, optimizer, c, arm, epoch, groups, out, budget)
  387         r["points"][str(epoch)] = point
  388         point["train_metrics"] = {}
  389         for role in ("fit", "calibration"):
  390             scores = np.load(out / point["scores"][role]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
  391             truth = np.asarray([g.labels for g in groups[role]], dtype=np.uint8)
  392             matrix, counts = metrics.group_metrics(truth, scores)
  393             path = out / "scores" / f"epoch{epoch}_{role}_metrics.npy"
  394             np.save(path, matrix, allow_pickle=False)
  395             point["train_metrics"][role] = {"file": data.record(path, out), "counts": counts,
  396                 "stable_bce_by_group": np.mean(np.logaddexp(0., scores.astype(np.float64)) - truth * scores, axis=1).tolist()}
  397         if epoch == 6:
  398             truth = np.asarray([g.labels for g in groups["calibration"]], dtype=np.uint8)
  399             scores = np.load(out / point["scores"]["calibration"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
  400             calibrated = calibrate(truth, scores, [x["domain"] for x in partition_rows["calibration"]])
  401             calibrated.update(model_state_sha256=point["model_state_sha256"], epoch=6,
  402                               score_sha256=point["scores"]["calibration"]["sha256"])
  403             data.write_json(out / "calibration.json", calibrated)
  404             r["calibration"] = data.record(out / "calibration.json", out)
  405         data.write_json(out / "progress.json", r)
  406     r.update(updates=864, formal_training_seconds=total_training,
  407              group_schedule_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data.json_bytes([g.uid for g in rows])).hexdigest(),
  408              dropout_stream=seed)
  409     torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
  410     r["resources"] = {
  411         "arm_seconds_before_cleanup": time.monotonic() - arm_started,
  412         "gpu_device": device, "gpu_name": torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),
  413         "initial_allocated_bytes": initial_allocated, "initial_reserved_bytes": initial_reserved,
  414         "peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device),
  415         "peak_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(device),
  416         "scope": "PyTorch CUDA allocator, reset immediately before arm model loading through both checkpoints and calibration; includes baseline allocations, excludes earlier public preflight and later cleanup. Not total device memory or other processes."
  417     }
  418     del optimizer, model
  419     gc.collect()
  420     torch.cuda.empty_cache()
  421     data.write_json(out / "manifest.json", r)
  422     return r
  423 
  424 
  425 def preflight_model(c: dict, arm: str, groups: dict, budget: persistence.Budget) -> dict:
  426     """Public text/tokenization and actual forward only; zero supervised updates."""
  427     import torch
  428     cfg = model_config(c, arm)
  429     files = core.model_files(cfg)
  430     if any(files[key] != c["models"][arm][key]
  431            for key in ("file_count", "total_size_bytes", "content_sha256")):
  432         raise ValueError("Archived pretrained model bytes differ")
  433     model = load_model(c, arm)
  434     maximum, records = 0, 0
  435     for split in ("train", "development"):
  436         for group in groups[split]:
  437             budget.check()
  438             texts = record_texts(group, c["interventions"][arm]["representation"])
  439             batch = model.encoder.tokenizer(texts, padding=False, truncation=False)
  440             lengths = [len(row) for row in batch["input_ids"]]
  441             maximum, records = max(maximum, max(lengths)), records + len(lengths)
  442             if maximum > c["input"]["token_budget"]:
  443                 raise ValueError("A complete public record exceeds token budget")
  444     blind = score(model, groups["train"][:1], c, arm, budget.check)
  445     result = {"pretrained": files, "max_tokens": maximum, "records_checked": records,
  446               "initial_model_state_sha256": core.state_digest(model.state_dict()),
  447               "actual_forward_shape": list(blind.shape), "supervision_reads": 0, "updates": 0}
  448     del model
  449     gc.collect()
  450     torch.cuda.empty_cache()
  451     return result
  452 
  453 
  454 def require_cpu_contracts() -> dict:
  455     sys.path.insert(0, str(data.ROOT / "tests"))
  456     suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName("test_step28_chinese_base_contracts")
  457     result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
  458     if not result.wasSuccessful() or result.skipped or result.testsRun != CPU_CONTRACT_COUNT:
  459         raise RuntimeError("All Chinese CPU contracts must pass without skips")
  460     return {"passed": result.testsRun, "skipped": 0}
  461 
  462 
  463 def run(out: Path) -> dict:
  464     import torch
  465     c = contract()
  466     runtime = c["runtime"]
  467     if (platform.system() != "Linux" or not torch.cuda.is_available()
  468             or torch.cuda.device_count() != 1 or not torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported()):
  469         raise RuntimeError("Requires separately resumed Linux stage and one eligible visible GPU")
  470     available = next(int(row.split()[1]) * 1024 for row in Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines()
  471                      if row.startswith("MemAvailable:"))
  472     if (torch.cuda.mem_get_info()[0] < runtime["minimum_free_gpu_bytes"]
  473             or available < runtime["minimum_free_host_bytes"]
  474             or shutil.disk_usage(data.ROOT).free < runtime["maximum_output_bytes"]):
  475         raise RuntimeError("Insufficient shared resources; wait")
  476     if out.exists() or not out.is_relative_to((data.ROOT / "reports").resolve()):
  477         raise ValueError("Use a new project reports run directory")
  478     out.mkdir(parents=True)
  479     budget = persistence.Budget(out.parent, c)
  480     snapshot = sources()
  481     r = {"status": "RUNNING", "config": c, "source_files": snapshot, "arms": {},
  482          "label_parses": {"train": 0, "development": 0, "heldout": 0, "owners": 0},
  483          "environment": {"python": platform.python_version(), "torch": torch.__version__,
  484                          "cuda": torch.version.cuda, "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}}
  485     data.write_json(out / "startup.json", r)
  486     try:
  487         torch.set_num_threads(1)
  488         torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
  489         torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
  490         torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
  491         torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
  492         r["torch_contracts"] = require_cpu_contracts()
  493         groups, metadata, checked = public.public_inputs(c)
  494         _, partition_rows = partition(groups, metadata, c)
  495         data.write_json(out / "partition.json", partition_rows)
  496         r["partition"] = data.record(out / "partition.json", out)
  497         r["inputs"] = checked
  498         preflights = {arm: preflight_model(c, arm, groups, budget) for arm in ARMS}
  499         for left, right in (("mean_bce", "mean_rank"), ("split_bce", "split_rank")):
  500             if preflights[left]["initial_model_state_sha256"] != preflights[right]["initial_model_state_sha256"]:
  501                 raise ValueError("Objective comparison must share the exact initial model state")
  502         r["preflights"] = preflights
  503         data.write_json(out / "preflight.json", r)
  504         data.write_json(out / "access.json", {"train_parse_attempts": 1, "development": 0, "heldout": 0, "owners": 0})
  505         r["label_parses"]["train"] = 1
  506         groups["train"] = public.attach_labels(groups["train"], c, "train")
  507         selected, aligned = partition(groups, metadata, c)
  508         if aligned != partition_rows:
  509             raise ValueError("Supervision changed the public partition")
  510         for arm in ARMS:
  511             result = train_arm(out / arm, arm, c, selected, partition_rows, budget, preflights[arm])
  512             r["arms"][arm] = {"manifest": data.record(out / arm / "manifest.json", out),
  513                                "updates": result["updates"], "formal_training_seconds": result["formal_training_seconds"]}
  514             data.write_json(out / "progress.json", r)
  515         if sources() != snapshot:
  516             raise ValueError("Source files changed during execution")
  517         r.update(status=COMPLETE, physical_updates=sum(x["updates"] for x in r["arms"].values()),
  518                  formal_training_seconds=sum(x["formal_training_seconds"] for x in r["arms"].values()),
  519                  budget=budget.state())
  520         if r["physical_updates"] != 3456:
  521             raise ValueError("Unexpected formal update count")
  522         data.write_json(out / "manifest.json", r)
  523         verify_models(out)
  524         data.write_json(out / "completion.json", {"status": COMPLETE, "budget": budget.state(),
  525                         "manifest_sha256": data.sha256(out / "manifest.json")})
  526         return r
  527     except Exception as error:
  528         data.write_json(out / "failure.json", {"status": "FAILED_NO_RETRY_OR_PARTIAL_EVALUATION",
  529             "error_type": type(error).__name__, "error": str(error), "label_parses": r["label_parses"]})
  530         raise
  531 
  532 
  533 def verify_models(out: Path) -> dict:
  534     r = data.read_json(out / "manifest.json")
  535     path = out / "model_verification.json"
  536     if r["status"] != COMPLETE or path.exists() or (out / "failure.json").exists():
  537         raise ValueError("Only a complete run and new model receipt are permitted")
  538     records = []
  539     for arm in ARMS:
  540         a = data.read_json(data.verify(out / r["arms"][arm]["manifest"]["path"], r["arms"][arm]["manifest"]))
  541         for epoch in ("3", "6"):
  542             model = a["points"][epoch]["model"]
  543             actual = data.verify(out / arm / model["path"], model)
  544             records.append(data.record(actual, out))
  545     result = {"status": "EIGHT_MODELS_FRESH_SIZE_SHA_VERIFIED", "files": records,
  546               "manifest_sha256": data.sha256(out / "manifest.json")}
  547     data.write_json(path, result)
  548     return result
  549 
  550 
  551 def load_array(path: Path, record: dict, shape: tuple, dtype: Any) -> np.ndarray:
  552     a = np.load(data.verify(path, record), allow_pickle=False)
  553     if a.shape != shape or a.dtype != dtype or not np.isfinite(a).all():
  554         raise ValueError("Saved score/metric shape or dtype differs")
  555     return a
  556 
  557 
  558 def validated_run(out: Path, c: dict, groups: dict, metadata: list, checked: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
  559     if (out / "failure.json").exists() or (out.parent / "exit_status.txt").read_text().strip() != "0":
  560         raise ValueError("Failed or incomplete outer job")
  561     for name in ("started.txt", "finished.txt", "resource_usage.log"):
  562         if not (out.parent / name).is_file():
  563             raise ValueError("Missing outer execution evidence")
  564     started = datetime.fromisoformat((out.parent / "started.txt").read_text().strip())
  565     finished = datetime.fromisoformat((out.parent / "finished.txt").read_text().strip())
  566     if (started.utcoffset() is None or finished.utcoffset() is None
  567             or not 0 <= (finished - started).total_seconds() <= c["runtime"]["maximum_gpu_stage_seconds"] + 60):
  568         raise ValueError("Invalid outer job timing")
  569     r = data.read_json(out / "manifest.json")
  570     if (r["status"] != COMPLETE or r["config"] != c or r["source_files"] != sources()
  571             or set(r["arms"]) != set(ARMS) or r["physical_updates"] != 3456
  572             or r["inputs"] != checked or r["torch_contracts"] != {"passed": CPU_CONTRACT_COUNT, "skipped": 0}
  573             or r["label_parses"] != {"train": 1, "development": 0, "heldout": 0, "owners": 0}):
  574         raise ValueError("Incomplete/stale base-model stage")
  575     completion = data.read_json(out / "completion.json")
  576     if completion["status"] != COMPLETE or completion["manifest_sha256"] != data.sha256(out / "manifest.json"):
  577         raise ValueError("Completion is not bound to this manifest")
  578     for budget in (r["budget"], completion["budget"]):
  579         if (not 0 <= budget["elapsed_seconds"] < c["runtime"]["maximum_gpu_stage_seconds"]
  580                 or not 0 <= budget["peak_observed_bytes"] <= c["runtime"]["maximum_output_bytes"]):
  581             raise ValueError("Budget exceeded")
  582     selected, part = partition(groups, metadata, c)
  583     saved_part = data.read_json(data.verify(out / r["partition"]["path"], r["partition"]))
  584     if saved_part != part:
  585         raise ValueError("Saved fitting/calibration group mapping differs")
  586     rows, seed = schedule(selected["fit"], c)
  587     expected_schedule = hashlib.sha256(data.json_bytes([g.uid for g in rows])).hexdigest()
  588     result, expected_models = {}, []
  589     for arm in ARMS:
  590         ar = r["arms"][arm]
  591         if ar["manifest"]["path"] != f"{arm}/manifest.json" or ar["updates"] != 864:
  592             raise ValueError("Arm identity or update count differs")
  593         a = data.read_json(data.verify(out / ar["manifest"]["path"], ar["manifest"]))
  594         pre = a["preflight"]
  595         if (a["arm"] != arm or a["label_parses"] != 0 or a["updates"] != 864
  596                 or a["group_schedule_sha256"] != expected_schedule or a["dropout_stream"] != seed
  597                 or a["fit_group_ids"] != [g.uid for g in selected["fit"]]
  598                 or a["calibration_group_ids"] != [g.uid for g in selected["calibration"]]
  599                 or set(a["points"]) != {"3", "6"} or len(a["training"]) != 2
  600                 or pre != r["preflights"][arm] or pre["updates"] != 0 or pre["supervision_reads"] != 0
  601                 or pre["actual_forward_shape"] != [1, 378] or not 0 < pre["max_tokens"] <= 256
  602                 or pre["records_checked"] != 24103 * (2 if c["interventions"][arm]["representation"] == "separate_moments" else 1)):
  603             raise ValueError("Training supply, prefix preflight, or scope differs")
  604         if any(pre["pretrained"][key] != c["models"][arm][key]
  605                for key in ("file_count", "total_size_bytes", "content_sha256")):
  606             raise ValueError("Pretrained model source differs")
  607         for log, start, stop in zip(a["training"], (0, 432), (432, 864), strict=True):
  608             if (log["start"] != start or log["stop"] != stop or log["updates"] != 432
  609                     or set(log["first_update_modules"]) != {"encoder", "head"}
  610                     or any(v != {"finite_nonzero_gradient": True, "parameters_changed": True}
  611                            for v in log["first_update_modules"].values())):
  612                 raise ValueError("Actual optimizer/encoder/head evidence is incomplete")
  613             losses = log["losses_by_epoch"]
  614             if (set(losses) != {"bce", "rank", "total"}
  615                     or any(np.asarray(v).shape != (3,) or not np.isfinite(v).all() for v in losses.values())
  616                     or not np.allclose(losses["total"], np.asarray(losses["bce"]) +
  617                                        c["interventions"][arm]["rank_weight"] * np.asarray(losses["rank"]),
  618                                        rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7)):
  619                 raise ValueError("Saved objective components differ from the frozen intervention")
  620         points = {}
  621         for epoch in ("3", "6"):
  622             p = a["points"][epoch]
  623             if (p["arm"] != arm or p["epoch"] != int(epoch)
  624                     or not p["full_model_and_adam_reloaded"] or set(p["scores"]) != set(ROLES)
  625                     or not p["model"]["actual_reload_verified"]
  626                     or p["model"]["path"] != f"models/epoch{epoch}.pt"):
  627                 raise ValueError("Incomplete or mismatched model/score checkpoint")
  628             arrays = {}
  629             for role in ROLES:
  630                 rec = p["scores"][role]
  631                 if rec["path"] != f"scores/epoch{epoch}_{role}.npy":
  632                     raise ValueError("Score role or point mismatch")
  633                 arrays[role] = load_array(out / arm / rec["path"], rec, (ROLE_SIZES[role], 378), np.float32)
  634             for role in ("fit", "calibration"):
  635                 rec = p["train_metrics"][role]["file"]
  636                 if rec["path"] != f"scores/epoch{epoch}_{role}_metrics.npy":
  637                     raise ValueError("Metric role or point mismatch")
  638                 load_array(out / arm / rec["path"], rec, (ROLE_SIZES[role], 22), np.float64)
  639             points[epoch] = arrays
  640             expected_models.append({k: p["model"][k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")}
  641                                    | {"path": f"{arm}/models/epoch{epoch}.pt"})
  642         if a["calibration"]["path"] != "calibration.json":
  643             raise ValueError("Calibration file role differs")
  644         cal = data.read_json(data.verify(out / arm / a["calibration"]["path"], a["calibration"]))
  645         point = a["points"]["6"]
  646         if (cal["epoch"] != 6 or cal["source_role"] != "train_calibration_only"
  647                 or cal["prediction"] != "float64(logit)>=float64(threshold)"
  648                 or cal["model_state_sha256"] != point["model_state_sha256"]
  649                 or cal["score_sha256"] != point["scores"]["calibration"]["sha256"]
  650                 or set(cal["bounds"]) != set("ABC")):
  651             raise ValueError("Threshold is not tied to this model's calibration scores")
  652         counts = np.asarray(cal["counts_by_group"])
  653         if (counts.shape != (36, 4) or counts.dtype.kind not in "iu" or (counts < 0).any()
  654                 or not np.all(counts[:, 0] + counts[:, 2] == 20)
  655                 or not np.all(counts[:, 1] + counts[:, 3] == 358)):
  656             raise ValueError("Calibration group counts differ")
  657         for d in "ABC":
  658             mask = np.asarray([row["domain"] for row in part["calibration"]]) == d
  659             bound = cal["bounds"][d]
  660             if (bound["negative_pairs"] != 4296 or bound["allowed_false_positives"] != 4
  661                     or counts[mask].sum(0).tolist() != cal["counts_by_domain"][d]
  662                     or bound["threshold"] != float(np.nextafter(np.float64(bound["next_negative_logit"]), np.inf))
  663                     or cal["counts_by_domain"][d][1] > 4):
  664                 raise ValueError("Calibration boundary/count metadata differs")
  665         if not np.isfinite(cal["threshold"]) or cal["threshold"] != max(x["threshold"] for x in cal["bounds"].values()):
  666             raise ValueError("Not the single globally fixed calibration threshold")
  667         result[arm] = {"points": points, "threshold": cal["threshold"]}
  668     receipt = data.read_json(out / "model_verification.json")
  669     if (receipt["status"] != "EIGHT_MODELS_FRESH_SIZE_SHA_VERIFIED"
  670             or receipt["manifest_sha256"] != data.sha256(out / "manifest.json")
  671             or receipt["files"] != expected_models):
  672         raise ValueError("Missing or mismatched actual Linux model hash receipt")
  673     # Evaluation now runs on Linux alongside retained weights. A historical
  674     # receipt cannot establish that the actual model files still match today.
  675     for model in expected_models:
  676         data.verify(out / model["path"], model)
  677     return result, part, r
  678 
  679 
  680 def rates(counts: np.ndarray) -> dict:
  681     tp, fp, fn, tn = np.asarray(counts, dtype=np.float64).sum(axis=0)
  682     return {"tp": int(tp), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn), "tn": int(tn),
  683             "fpr": float(fp / (fp + tn)), "recall": float(tp / (tp + fn)),
  684             "precision": float(tp / (tp + fp)) if tp + fp else 0.,
  685             "f1": float(2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn)) if 2 * tp + fp + fn else 0.}
  686 
  687 
  688 def fixed_classification(counts: list[dict], domains: list[str]) -> dict:
  689     """Sum saved per-group confusion counts before calculating classification rates."""
  690     values = np.asarray([[row[key] for key in ("tp", "fp", "fn", "tn")]
  691                          for row in counts], dtype=np.int64)
  692     if values.shape != (len(domains), 4) or set(domains) != set("ABC") or np.any(values < 0):
  693         raise ValueError("Invalid saved confusion counts/domain alignment")
  694     return {"threshold": 0.0, "pooled": rates(values),
  695             "by_domain": {d: rates(values[np.asarray(domains) == d]) for d in "ABC"},
  696             "aggregation": "Sum confusion counts before computing rates; distinct from mean per-group metrics."}
  697 
  698 
  699 def automatic_report(counts: np.ndarray, domains: list[str], draws: np.ndarray) -> dict:
  700     out = {}
  701     domain_boot_counts = []
  702     for index, domain in enumerate("ABC"):
  703         rows = np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(domains) == domain)
  704         values = counts[rows]
  705         point = rates(values)
  706         boot = values[draws[:, index]].sum(axis=1).astype(np.float64)
  707         domain_boot_counts.append(boot)
  708         fpr = boot[:, 1] / (boot[:, 1] + boot[:, 3])
  709         recall = boot[:, 0] / (boot[:, 0] + boot[:, 2])
  710         precision = np.divide(boot[:, 0], boot[:, 0] + boot[:, 1],
  711                               out=np.zeros(len(boot)), where=boot[:, 0] + boot[:, 1] > 0)
  712         point["conditional_95pct_intervals"] = {k: np.quantile(v, [.025, .975]).tolist()
  713                                                  for k, v in (("fpr", fpr), ("recall", recall), ("precision", precision))}
  714         point["passes_point_gates"] = point["fp"] * 1000 <= point["fp"] + point["tn"] and point["tp"] * 2 >= point["tp"] + point["fn"]
  715         out[domain] = point
  716     pooled = rates(counts)
  717     boot = np.stack(domain_boot_counts).sum(axis=0)
  718     fpr = boot[:, 1] / (boot[:, 1] + boot[:, 3])
  719     recall = boot[:, 0] / (boot[:, 0] + boot[:, 2])
  720     precision = np.divide(boot[:, 0], boot[:, 0] + boot[:, 1],
  721                           out=np.zeros(len(boot)), where=boot[:, 0] + boot[:, 1] > 0)
  722     pooled["conditional_95pct_intervals"] = {k: np.quantile(v, [.025, .975]).tolist()
  723                                              for k, v in (("fpr", fpr), ("recall", recall), ("precision", precision))}
  724     return {"by_domain": out, "pooled": pooled,
  725             "all_domains_pass": all(v["passes_point_gates"] for v in out.values()),
  726             "interval_scope": "Group bootstrap conditional on fixed models, calibration groups and thresholds; zero observed FP may produce [0,0], not a population upper bound or deployment guarantee."}
  727 
  728 
  729 def automatic_comparison(candidate: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray,
  730                          domains: list[str], draws: np.ndarray) -> dict:
  731     """Paired group resampling at each model's already fixed threshold."""
  732     rows = [np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(domains) == d) for d in "ABC"]
  733     bootstrap = [np.stack([counts[index][draws[:, j]].sum(1)
  734                            for j, index in enumerate(rows)], axis=1)
  735                  for counts in (candidate, reference)]
  736     result = {}
  737     for name, numerator, other in (("fpr", 1, 3), ("recall", 0, 2), ("precision", 0, 1)):
  738         scopes = {}
  739         for domain_index, scope in enumerate((*"ABC", "pooled")):
  740             values, points = [], []
  741             for counts, sampled in zip((candidate, reference), bootstrap, strict=True):
  742                 totals = sampled[:, domain_index] if scope != "pooled" else sampled.sum(1)
  743                 denom = totals[:, numerator] + totals[:, other]
  744                 values.append(np.divide(totals[:, numerator], denom,
  745                                         out=np.zeros(len(totals)), where=denom > 0))
  746                 points.append(rates(counts[rows[domain_index]] if scope != "pooled" else counts)[name])
  747             scopes[scope] = {"difference": points[0] - points[1],
  748                              "conditional_95pct_interval": np.quantile(values[0] - values[1], [.025, .975]).tolist()}
  749         result[name] = scopes
  750     return result
  751 
  752 
  753 def historical_reference(c: dict, partition_rows: dict) -> dict:
  754     """Reuse frozen predictions, not archived weights or a new historical label parse."""
  755     records = c["historical_reference"]["files"]
  756     paths = {name: data.verify(data.ROOT / row["path"], row) for name, row in records.items()}
  757     parent = data.read_json(paths["manifest.json"])
  758     completion = data.read_json(paths["completion.json"])
  759     arm = data.read_json(paths["labse/manifest.json"])
  760     calibration = data.read_json(paths["labse/calibration.json"])
  761     score_record = records["labse/scores/epoch6_development.npy"]
  762     if (parent["status"] != "COMPLETE_BASE_MODELS_2592_CALIBRATED_VALID_BLIND"
  763             or completion["manifest_sha256"] != records["manifest.json"]["sha256"]
  764             or data.read_json(paths["partition.json"]) != partition_rows
  765             or parent["arms"]["labse"]["manifest"]["sha256"] != records["labse/manifest.json"]["sha256"]
  766             or arm["points"]["6"]["scores"]["development"]["sha256"] != score_record["sha256"]
  767             or arm["calibration"]["sha256"] != records["labse/calibration.json"]["sha256"]
  768             or calibration["model_state_sha256"] != arm["points"]["6"]["model_state_sha256"]):
  769         raise ValueError("Historical LaBSE prediction/calibration/partition binding differs")
  770     return {"scores": load_array(paths["labse/scores/epoch6_development.npy"], score_record,
  771                                   (60, 378), np.float32),
  772             "threshold": calibration["threshold"], "files": records}
  773 
  774 
  775 def metric_comparison(candidate: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray,
  776                       domains: list[str], draws: np.ndarray) -> dict:
  777     domain_rows = [np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(domains) == d) for d in "ABC"]
  778     result = {}
  779     for i, column in enumerate(metrics.COLUMNS):
  780         delta = candidate[:, i] - reference[:, i]
  781         boot = np.stack([delta[rows][draws[:, j]].mean(1)
  782                          for j, rows in enumerate(domain_rows)]).mean(0)
  783         result[column] = {"mean": float(delta.mean()),
  784                           "conditional_95pct_interval": np.quantile(boot, [.025, .975]).tolist()}
  785     return result
  786 
  787 
  788 def evaluate(out: Path, destination: Path) -> dict:
  789     if platform.system() != "Linux" or destination.exists():
  790         raise ValueError("Requires resumed Linux evaluation and a new directory")
  791     c = contract()
  792     groups, metadata, checked = public.public_inputs(c)
  793     arrays, part, r = validated_run(out, c, groups, metadata, checked)
  794     reference = historical_reference(c, part)
  795     destination.mkdir(parents=True)
  796     data.write_json(destination / "access.json", {"status": "ALL_FOUR_MODELS_COMPLETE_BEFORE_VALID",
  797                     "development_parse_attempts": 1, "train": 0, "heldout": 0, "owners": 0})
  798     try:
  799         labelled = public.attach_labels(groups["development"], c, "development")
  800         truth = np.asarray([g.labels for g in labelled], dtype=np.uint8)
  801         e = c["evaluation"]
  802         domains = [row["domain"] for row in part["development"]]
  803         result = {"status": "CHINESE_BASE_METRICS_COLLECTED_BEFORE_UNCERTAINTY", "config": c,
  804                   "manifest_sha256": data.sha256(out / "manifest.json"), "columns": list(metrics.COLUMNS),
  805                   "label_parses": {"train": 0, "development": 1, "heldout": 0, "owners": 0},
  806                   "arms": {}, "comparisons": {}, "primary_comparison": c["primary_comparison"],
  807                   "domains": domains, "group_ids": [row["group_uid"] for row in part["development"]],
  808                   "partition": r["partition"],
  809                   "historical_reference": reference["files"],
  810                   "formal_training_seconds": r["formal_training_seconds"]}
  811         matrices, auto_counts = {}, {}
  812         for arm in ARMS:
  813             (destination / arm).mkdir()
  814             points = {}
  815             for epoch in ("3", "6"):
  816                 scores = arrays[arm]["points"][epoch]["development"]
  817                 matrix, counts = metrics.group_metrics(truth, scores)
  818                 path = destination / arm / f"epoch{epoch}_metrics.npy"
  819                 np.save(path, matrix, allow_pickle=False)
  820                 points[epoch] = {"file": data.record(path, destination), "counts_at_logit_zero": counts,
  821                                  "fixed_classification": fixed_classification(counts, domains),
  822                                  "mean": dict(zip(metrics.COLUMNS, matrix.mean(0).tolist())),
  823                                  "by_domain": {d: dict(zip(metrics.COLUMNS, matrix[np.asarray(domains) == d].mean(0).tolist())) for d in "ABC"}}
  824                 if epoch == "6":
  825                     matrices[arm] = matrix
  826                     count = binary_counts(truth, scores, arrays[arm]["threshold"])
  827                     auto_counts[arm] = count
  828                     automatic = {"threshold": arrays[arm]["threshold"], "counts_by_group": count.tolist()}
  829             result["arms"][arm] = {"points": points, "automatic_classification": automatic}
  830         matrices["historical_labse"], historical_counts = metrics.group_metrics(truth, reference["scores"])
  831         auto_counts["historical_labse"] = binary_counts(truth, reference["scores"], reference["threshold"])
  832         path = destination / "historical_labse_metrics.npy"
  833         np.save(path, matrices["historical_labse"], allow_pickle=False)
  834         result["historical_labse"] = {"file": data.record(path, destination),
  835             "counts_at_logit_zero": historical_counts,
  836             "fixed_classification": fixed_classification(historical_counts, domains),
  837             "threshold": reference["threshold"], "counts_by_group": auto_counts["historical_labse"].tolist()}
  838         # Persist all nine matrices and all counts before ANY uncertainty calculation.
  839         data.write_json(destination / "collected.json", result)
  840         draws = np.random.default_rng(e["bootstrap_seed"]).integers(
  841             0, 20, size=(e["bootstrap_replicates"], 3, 20))
  842         for arm in ARMS:
  843             raw = result["arms"][arm]["automatic_classification"]
  844             result["arms"][arm]["automatic_classification"] = {
  845                 **automatic_report(auto_counts[arm], domains, draws), **raw}
  846         result["historical_labse"]["automatic_classification"] = automatic_report(
  847             auto_counts["historical_labse"], domains, draws)
  848         for candidate, baseline in c["comparisons"]:
  849             result["comparisons"][f"{candidate}_minus_{baseline}"] = {
  850                 "metrics": metric_comparison(matrices[candidate], matrices[baseline], domains, draws),
  851                 "automatic": automatic_comparison(auto_counts[candidate], auto_counts[baseline], domains, draws)}
  852         result["interpretation"] = "Each domain's fixed-threshold FPR<=0.001 AND recall>=0.5 is required. Point-value development qualification, not independent test, training-seed robustness, calibrated deployment guarantee, or automatic model selection. AP comparisons are secondary."
  853         result["status"] = "CHINESE_BASE_DEVELOPMENT_EVALUATED_NO_AUTOMATIC_WINNER"
  854         data.write_json(destination / "evaluation.json", result)
  855         return result
  856     except Exception as error:
  857         data.write_json(destination / "failure.json", {"status": "EVALUATION_FAILED_NO_RETRY",
  858                         "error_type": type(error).__name__, "error": str(error)})
  859         raise
  860 
  861 
  862 def main() -> None:
  863     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
  864     parser.add_argument("action", choices=("train", "evaluate", "verify-models"))
  865     parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
  866     parser.add_argument("--evaluation", type=Path)
  867     args = parser.parse_args()
  868     if args.action == "evaluate" and args.evaluation is None:
  869         parser.error("evaluate requires --evaluation")
  870     if args.action == "train":
  871         result = run(args.out.resolve())
  872     elif args.action == "evaluate":
  873         result = evaluate(args.out.resolve(), args.evaluation.resolve())
  874     else:
  875         result = verify_models(args.out.resolve())
  876     print(data.json_bytes({"status": result["status"], "out": str(args.out)}).decode())
  877 
  878 
  879 if __name__ == "__main__":
  880     main()
